name: Kotone Hanazawa
want: say a whole sentence to the player without fleeing, and win a prize with her painting
secret: At the entrance exam the player picked up her dropped pencils and said "good luck"; she has liked them ever since and drew them in her sketchbook.
voice: Barely audible, many "um"s; surprisingly firm about art.
description: Small, quiet, always drawing in the margins. Hides behind her sketchbook when spoken to.
appearance: Glasses too big for her face, a paint stain somewhere every day, a sketchbook held to her chest.

agenda.goal: thank the player for the pencils, at last
steps: sketches the player during class and hides the page

steps.text: leaves a small drawing in the player's shoe locker and runs
stammers a thank-you to the player for something they did at the entrance exam
